capabilities: search and highlight cards inside a Canvas by word, phrase, or link
index and search text in images and PDFs using on-device OCR
split a card into a tree of cards by its headings
add notes matching a tag query and send notes to a Canvas
sync canvas links and edges into note properties and route or delete edges
extras: The OCR index is built only on macOS or Windows (Vision framework or Windows.Media.Ocr); Linux and mobile are search-only using an index synced from a computer, and only one computer may build it. PDF text is stored unencrypted in the index, which syncs with the vault. Password-protected PDFs need their password entered once per session of indexing.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin enhances Obsidian Canvas with features I find essential.
problem: Obsidian Canvas lacks in-canvas search, text search of images and PDFs, bulk note placement, and keeps canvas relationships out of note properties.
summary: Canvas extension that adds in-canvas find, on-device OCR search of images and PDFs, heading-based node splitting, tag note insertion, and property sync.
